args.subject: Request for a free consultation
args.body:
Hello,

I received your email about your event-organizing services and would like to book the free consultation you offered. Please let me know your available times and any information you need from me to arrange it.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson

final_text: I emailed bookings@best-event-organizers.com to request a free consultation and asked for their available times.
